svg.title: P13: Log-as-queue loops collaboration and interaction

text.tspan: Primitive · A² A1/A3 · stream role collaboration
Drive work from a durable execution record.
New work is represented by durable append-only
A consumer polls or subscribes to unseen records.
Event identity, append order, consumer cursor, and
Work advances from the log without replaying
Records have stable identity and consumers
Each effectful unit has an idempotency or
1 append(event) → 2 consume(cursor) → 3 apply(effect) → 4 record(effect) → 5 acknowledge(effect) → 6 replay(cursor)
Evidence: 24/41 repositories, 22/36 families; 24 trajectories (11 multi-checkpoint); exact audit: not sampled.
Variation: SQL log, file log, queue adapter, polling, and projection.
Negative control: An in-memory queue is not log-as-queue.
